source.stem:
Which of the following options regarding Darwin’s theory of natural selection is incorrect ( )
A. All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
B. If living things want to survive, they must fight for survival in order to obtain food and space.
C. Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
D. Organisms that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

options.text: All living things generally have strong reproductive capabilities
If living things want to survive, they have to fight for food and space.
Variations produced by organisms must be conducive to adapting to the environment
Creatures that do not adapt to the environment will be eliminated

intelligence.enrichment: A food item may show the presence of more than one nutrient; peanuts show the presence of both proteins and fats. multiple positive food-test results for one food item -> evidence that the item contains multiple nutrients The learner correctly applies this rule: A food item may show the presence of more than one nutrient; peanuts show the presence of both proteins and fats. Each food item belongs to exactly one nutrient group, so one positive test cancels the others.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Mindful eating: a path to a healthy body. The student must decide: Explain from food-test results that one food item can contain more than one nutrient, such as peanuts showing both proteins and fats. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Rewrite the figure and the stem so they agree. Exactly one visual. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
